shots.prompt: WIDE SHOT. A warm elderly Bulgarian grandmother in a traditional embroidered dress and headscarf slowly stirs a clay pot of thick white yogurt in a rustic mountain kitchen, steam rising, warm candlelight and morning glow through a small window. Tender, timeless, photorealistic.

CLOSE-UP. The weathered hands of an old Bulgarian grandmother lift a wooden spoon of extremely thick white yogurt from a clay pot, then she looks up with a warm knowing smile toward the camera. Soft warm light, deep wrinkles, authentic, photorealistic, shallow depth of field.

MEDIUM SHOT. The Bulgarian grandmother sets a clear glass jar of thick white yogurt down on a worn wooden table beside fresh berries and a honeycomb, and nods proudly. Rustic warm kitchen, golden window light, photorealistic.
